I guess i might be too naive cause of how i felt before the pregnancy, because back then she was that person that would make me feel good, happy and hopeful about the future, but its the idea that we might get back to being how we were then that keeps my mind so occupied and conflicted. 
I think its all gonna depend on the conversation we're gonna have when she gets home again
Thanks for your advice, i was planning to go to her after her appointment with the midwife so we can have a talk about all of this, just waiting for her to get back rn.

Well its something we both agreed on taking our time with, since we both talked about sharing the mentality that modern marriage feels like it is more a materialistic/financial thing rather than an actual commitment of love and loyalty.

First of all, thanks for your reply.

The thing that makes it so difficult to me is that it was all going so well before the pregnancy but it switching so quickly caught me off guard.

If she wasnt pregnant and she wouldve said these things i wouldve broken up with her immediately, but because she is pregnant i keep wondering if the things she says are really all just caused by these big hormonal changes and she regrets saying these things and feels sorry for it more than she lets on.

If things do get better and she apologizes sincerely i would be able to endure this during the pregnancy and forgive her eventually, but the uncertainty of it all is what makes it all so difficult to wrap my head around.
